title: What Is Prisma?
description: Understand Prisma as a next-generation ORM for Node.js and TypeScript, and why frontend developers should care about database access.

data.text: **Prisma** is an open-source database toolkit for Node.js and TypeScript. It replaces traditional ORMs like TypeORM, Sequelize, and Mongoose with a type-safe, auto-generated query builder that feels natural to frontend developers.

items: **Prisma Client** — A type-safe database client auto-generated from your schema
**Prisma Migrate** — A declarative migration system for evolving your database
**Prisma Studio** — A visual editor for your database data

data.text: Prisma was designed with TypeScript developers in mind. Every query is fully typed, so you get autocomplete and type checking without writing a single type definition. This makes it an excellent fit for Next.js and React developers who want type-safe database access.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: If you are coming from a frontend background, think of Prisma as an ORM that speaks TypeScript fluently. You define your data model once, and Prisma generates the types and client for you.
